sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.content: By accessing and using rSearch, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. Our AI-powered research assistant provides comprehensive search capabilities across multiple data sources, leveraging advanced reasoning through DeepSeek R1 technology.

sections.heading: 2. Service Description
sections.content: rSearch is a cutting-edge research assistant that harnesses artificial intelligence to deliver precise, well-reasoned responses to complex queries. We combine state-of-the-art language models, intelligent web searches, and sophisticated chain-of-thought reasoning to provide actionable insights backed by reliable sources.

sections.heading: 3. User Responsibilities
sections.content: Users agree to use the service responsibly and respect intellectual property rights. The service provides access to diverse content categories including web search, images, videos, news, places, shopping, academic content, and patent databases. Users must not attempt to automate queries without permission.

sections.heading: 4. Data Usage
sections.content: We process queries through our Chain-of-Thought process: query refinement, comprehensive data gathering via Serper.dev API, reasoning analysis using DeepSeek capabilities, and response synthesis. Your usage helps improve our AI models while maintaining privacy standards.

sections.heading: Data Collection
sections.content: We collect search queries and interaction patterns to power our AI-driven research assistant. This data helps train our DeepSeek R1 model for enhanced reasoning capabilities. We do not sell personal data to third parties.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Data
sections.content: Your data improves our query refinement, search accuracy, and reasoning processes. We use aggregated, anonymized data to enhance our Chain-of-Thought processing and develop new research capabilities.

sections.heading: Data Protection
sections.content: We employ industry-standard security measures to protect your data. All searches and AI processing are encrypted, and we regularly audit our security practices to maintain the highest standards.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.content: You maintain full control over your data, with rights to access, opt-out of non-essential collection, and delete account information at any time.

sections.heading: What is rSearch?
sections.content: rSearch is an AI-powered research assistant that revolutionizes how you discover and understand information. Unlike traditional search engines that return lists of links, rSearch provides intelligent, well-reasoned responses to complex queries by combining advanced AI reasoning with comprehensive data gathering.

sections.heading: Our Mission
sections.content: We believe that research should be about insights, not just results. Our mission is to help users discover deeper understanding through sophisticated AI reasoning, making complex information accessible and actionable for everyone.

sections.heading: How rSearch Works
sections.content: rSearch operates through a sophisticated Chain-of-Thought process: First, we intelligently refine your query to capture the essence of what you're looking for. Then, we gather comprehensive data from multiple sources using our Serper.dev API integration. Next, our DeepSeek R1 model analyzes this information through advanced reasoning. Finally, we synthesize everything into a clear, well-structured response that answers your question directly.

sections.heading: Advanced AI Technology
sections.content: At the heart of rSearch is the DeepSeek R1 model, a state-of-the-art AI system that excels in mathematical reasoning, code analysis, and logical thinking. This technology enables rSearch to understand context, draw connections between different pieces of information, and provide responses that go beyond simple fact retrieval.

sections.heading: Comprehensive Search Modes
sections.content: rSearch offers eight specialized search modes to meet your specific needs: Web Search for general internet queries, Images for visual content discovery, Videos for multimedia content, News for current events and updates, Places for location-based information, Shopping for product research and deals, Scholar for academic papers and research, and Patents for intellectual property exploration.

sections.heading: Modern User Experience
sections.content: Built with Next.js and TypeScript, rSearch features a responsive, modern interface that works seamlessly across all devices. Our intuitive design focuses on simplicity while providing powerful functionality, with features like mobile-optimized navigation, dynamic result displays, and smooth animations.

sections.heading: Privacy and Security
sections.content: Your privacy is paramount. We employ industry-standard encryption and security measures to protect your data. All searches are processed securely, and we never sell your personal information to third parties. You maintain full control over your data with options to access, modify, or delete your information at any time.

sections.heading: Continuous Improvement
sections.content: rSearch is constantly evolving. We regularly update our AI models, expand our data sources, and enhance our reasoning capabilities based on user feedback and the latest advances in artificial intelligence. This ensures that rSearch remains at the forefront of AI-powered research technology.
